answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in umber, expire in oasis, and dawn lists each expiry. An adversary running 183 aliases therefore needs 165 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 750 identities would post 1838 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
